source_checks.finding: Page (Computer version) has a Windows 11 path: Start, Settings, Apps, Default apps, search for Chrome, choose it, click 'Set default' next to the browser option. It confirms 'To make sure the change is applied to the correct file types,' before the file types check, and the note 'If you don't have Google Chrome on your computer yet, first download and install Chrome.' The card excerpt matches the page wording. Applicability to Windows 11 is confirmed.

Page confirms separate Windows 10 steps, with an 'Original version' path (System, then Default apps) and a 'Creators Update' path (Apps, then Default apps), then 'Web browser' and 'pick Chrome in the Choose an app window'. The card excerpt 'In the Choose an app window, select Google Chrome' is close but not the page's exact words; card fix: use 'pick Chrome in the Choose an app window'. The two Windows 10 versions differ, as the card says.

required_actions.action: Ask whether the computer runs Windows 11 or Windows 10, because the setting path differs by version
Install Chrome first (already completed: the user just put Chrome on the computer, so no repeat is needed)
